--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Arctan
theorem tan_add' {x y : ℝ}
    (h : (∀ k : ℤ, x ≠ (2 * k + 1) * π / 2) ∧ ∀ l : ℤ, y ≠ (2 * l + 1) * π / 2) :
    tan (x + y) = (tan x + tan y) / (1 - tan x * tan y) :=
  tan_add (Or.inl h)

--src: Mathlib.Data.Complex.Exponential
theorem tan_sq_div_one_add_tan_sq {x : ℝ} (hx : cos x ≠ 0) :
    tan x ^ 2 / (1 + tan x ^ 2) = sin x ^ 2 := by
  simp only [← tan_mul_cos hx, mul_pow, ← inv_one_add_tan_sq hx, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul]

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Arctan
theorem tan_two_mul {x : ℝ} : tan (2 * x) = 2 * tan x / (1 - tan x ^ 2) := by
  have := @Complex.tan_two_mul x
  norm_cast at *

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Arctan
lemma arctan_ne_mul_pi_div_two {x : ℝ} : ∀ (k : ℤ), arctan x ≠ (2 * k + 1) * π / 2 := by
  by_contra!
  obtain ⟨k, h⟩ := this
  obtain ⟨lb, ub⟩ := arctan_mem_Ioo x
  rw [h, neg_eq_neg_one_mul, mul_div_assoc, mul_lt_mul_right (by positivity)] at lb
  rw [h, ← one_mul (π / 2), mul_div_assoc, mul_lt_mul_right (by positivity)] at ub
  norm_cast at lb ub; change -1 < _ at lb; omega

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Arctan
theorem tan_int_mul_pi_div_two (n : ℤ) : tan (n * π / 2) = 0 :=
  tan_eq_zero_iff.mpr (by use n)

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.ComplexDeriv
theorem tendsto_abs_tan_atTop (k : ℤ) :
    Tendsto (fun x => abs (tan x)) (��[≠] ((2 * k + 1) * π / 2 : ℂ)) atTop :=
  tendsto_abs_tan_of_cos_eq_zero <| cos_eq_zero_iff.2 ⟨k, rfl⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.Complex.Exponential
nonrec theorem tan_eq_sin_div_cos : tan x = sin x / cos x :=
  ofReal_injective <| by simp only [ofReal_tan, tan_eq_sin_div_cos, ofReal_div, ofReal_sin,
    ofReal_cos]

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Complex
theorem sin_eq_one_iff {x : ℝ} : sin x = 1 ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, π / 2 + k * (2 * π) = x :=
  mod_cast @Complex.sin_eq_one_iff x

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
theorem tan_add_nat_mul_pi (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : tan (x + n * π) = tan x :=
  tan_periodic.nat_mul n x

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Complex
theorem tan_ne_zero_iff {θ : ℂ} : tan θ ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ k : ℤ, (k * π / 2 : ℂ) ≠ θ := by
  rw [← not_exists, not_iff_not, tan_eq_zero_iff]

/-- The real tangent function, defined as the real part of the complex tangent -/
@[pp_nodot]
nonrec def tan (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (tan x).re

Real.pi
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- The number π = 3.14159265... Defined here using choice as twice a zero of cos in [1,2], from
which one can derive all its properties. For explicit bounds on π, see `Data.Real.Pi.Bounds`.

Denoted `π`, once the `Real` namespace is opened. -/
protected noncomputable def pi : ℝ :=
  2 * Classical.choose exists_cos_eq_zero
